messages.subject: Definition of runExample function
parts: On the example page the function "runExample" is used. Where exactly can I find the definition of this function? Thanks.

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Definition of runExample function
parts:
Is this what you are looking for?

> shiny::runExample
function (example = NA, port = NULL, launch.browser = getOption("shiny.launch.browser", 
    interactive())) 
{
    examplesDir <- system.file("examples", package = "shiny")
    dir <- resolve(examplesDir, example)
    if (is.null(dir)) {
        if (is.na(example)) {
            errFun <- message
            errMsg <- ""
        }
        else {
            errFun <- stop
            errMsg <- paste("Example", example, "does not exist. ")
        }
        errFun(errMsg, "Valid examples are \"", paste(list.files(examplesDir), 
            collapse = "\", \""), "\"")
    }
    else {
        runApp(dir, port = port, launch.browser = launch.browser)
    }
}
<environment: namespace:shiny>

>
